name: Alpha
body: This is an alpha release of the addon. It's fully functional, although additional configuration is required(see readme). For best experience, usage of theese addons is recommended: ![succbag](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/17740865/38700607-7f1fb312-3e50-11e8-88cc-59d874991b0d.png) [SUCC-bag](https://www.google.com "SUCC-bag - player inventory and bank overhaul addon for world of warcraft 1.12.1") ![cooline](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/17740865/38700627-90c2d0ea-3e50-11e8-8003-211b89e2081b.png) [Cooline](https://github.com/shirsig/cooline) ![ringmenu](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/17740865/38701380-8b770d02-3e52-11e8-87bb-00c738290844.png) [RingMenu](https://github.com/jsb/RingMenu) ![castbar](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/17740865/38700654-a1438f90-3e50-11e8-8710-e2adb3a54a07.png) and a player castbar modification addon, for example, [Punschrulle](https://github.com/Attero/Punschrulle).
